metadata.gnssSource: /novatel/oem7/bestpos XY; reported uncertainty projected to UTM; recorded solution types are INS aided

inputMetadata.clock: INSPVA receiver time bridged from ROS headers; no pose used to fit the clock
inputMetadata.inputInterpolation: native wheel fusion; offline linear IMU/steering reconstruction

longitudinalVelocity.upstreamReconstruction: Offline linear IMU/steering reconstruction; native causal wheel packets

inputMetadata.reference: No reference returned; ODOM not read
inputMetadata.gpsInput: No GNSS channel exported; caller supplies BESTPOS
inputMetadata.lidarInput: accepted full/directional geometric samples; the continuous adapter rejects insufficient information

steeringInterfaceCalibration.scope: Recorded Mississippi MnCAV steering-curvature equivalence, not a measured road-wheel or INS mounting calibration.
steeringInterfaceCalibration.method: Fit steering_curvature = tan((steering_wheel_angle_rad - offset)/16.2)/3.089 using bag-time-paired topics. Fit 1.503989 degrees; round to 1.5 degrees. Validated on later calibration samples and the separate 12:09:31 drive.

provenance.identity: UMN identifies MnCAV as a 2021 Chrysler Pacifica Hybrid.
provenance.stock_specifications: 2273 kg EPA curb mass, 3.089 m wheelbase, 55.5/44.5 axle load split, 16.2 steering ratio; actual loaded MnCAV mass is unknown.
provenance.lf_lr: Derived static unladen CG distances from published axle load fractions.
provenance.yawInertia: Explicit uniform rectangular planform approximation, not a measured MnCAV inertia.
provenance.cornering_stiffness: Unidentified nominal prior: existing generic model stiffnesses scaled by the stock mass ratio. Not a manufacturer specification.
provenance.sensitivity: Repeat the experiment at 0.7 and 1.3 times nominal inertia and both axle stiffnesses; nominal mass and geometry remain fixed.
provenance.input_offsets: Fixed signs plus median offsets from the independent calibration drive; no online truth injection. Residual road-bank and sensor-to-CG lever-arm errors remain.

rejected_direct_identification.reason: Nonphysical solution and unknown INS-to-CG reference point. This drive does not establish calibrated MnCAV bicycle parameters.

synchronization.clock: Native LiDAR frames; no synthetic inter-frame localization outputs
synchronization.inputScope: Wheel/lateral estimates retain their native preprocessing; only aligned frame values enter localization

metadata.evaluation: INSPVA on native LiDAR frame timestamps, approximately 10 Hz
metadata.initialization: Common first LiDAR pose plus wheel/lateral velocity and IMU acceleration; not a cold-start GNSS-only test
metadata.limitations: Same-drive map and per-frame INSPVA matching seeds; shared receiver reference; unknown physical output-point transform; upstream motion preparation offline

continuousDesign.scope: Common continuous translation bound; conditional local heading ISS with available displacement/pose heading. No ISS during arbitrary simultaneous outages or stopped GNSS-only operation.
